title: Purple Lotus
wikitext:
'''Purple Lotus''' is an [[Herb]] found in [[Felwood]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (210).

==Source==
Purple Lotus can typically be found around troll, night elf and titan ruins in [[Felwood]]. There is a chance that one harvesting a Purple Lotus may find a [[Wildvine]].
Purple Lotus could also be found in the following zones:
*[[Tanaris|Tanaris]]
*[[Azshara|Azshara]]
*[[Stranglethorn Vale|Stranglethorn Vale]]
*[[Hinterlands|The Hinterlands]]
*[[Feralas|Feralas]]
*[[Badlands|Badlands]]
*[[Ashenvale|Ashenvale]]
*[[Dire Maul]]
*[[Zul'Gurub|Zul'Gurub]]

==Patch changes==
*{{Patch 0.10|note=Now stacks to 20.}}
